page.notes: Right margin: small "»" ornaments stand at most line ends. They are printer's line-end marks, not text, so they are not transcribed. Italic boundaries are approximate, judged from the scan. The first word is printed "Quòd" with a capital and no indent, so the paragraph is marked as continuing from the previous page. Spelling is copied as printed: "potetiam", "redemtio", "sacramento", "susceptam" and "pertransiunt" are read from the scan and kept as printed where legible. The word "pertranseunt" is read as "pertransiunt" in the text above and may need checking against the scan. The catchword "D" is a single letter and is read as a catchword from its position below the last line.
